title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP ( Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).

Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java, com foco em aplicações backend de alta performance;
  • Domínio de Java 11+, 21, Angular 17 e frameworks como Spring Boot / Spring Cloud;
  • Experiência com manipulação de dados em memória (Collections, Streams, otimização de uso de memória, Garbage Collector);
  • Conhecimento em programação multithread / paralelismo (Thread, ExecutorService, CompletableFuture, Async);
  • Vivência com integrações via APIs REST e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS, etc.);
  • Experiência em AWS (Amazon Web Services), incluindo: - Criação e manutenção de Lambda Functions, - Uso de S3, EC2, CloudWatch, RDS, DynamoDB,
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins);
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto (Design Patterns, SOLID, Clean Code, DDD);
  • Inglês avançado, capaz de se comunicar, participar de reuniões e elaborar documentação técnica.
  • Desejáveis / Diferenciais - Experiência no mercado financeiro (projetos de risco, pós-trade, middle/back office);
  • Conhecimento em event-driven architecture e microservices;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana);
  • Noções de segurança em aplicações e governança em nuvem.

Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver microserviços utilizando Java e Spring Boot

Integrar sistemas com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS e SNS)

Orquestrar containers em ambientes Kubernetes (K8s)

Criar e manter soluções em AWS (S3, Cognito)

Modelo hibrido 2x no cliente Faria Lima- SP

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

O Auditor de Obras irá atuar em conjunto com os gerentes de projeto e responsáveis técnicos da empresa, sendo responsável por acompanhar, inspecionar e avaliar a execução das obras e serviços relacionados à implantação da infraestrutura de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) e dos sistemas de operação do terminal de cargas. Seu objetivo principal é garantir a conformidade técnica, contratual e financeira dos trabalhos realizados, assegurando que os prazos, custos, especificações e padrões de qualidade sejam atendidos de acordo com o projeto executivo e as normas aplicáveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Realizar auditorias técnicas e documentais nas obras de implantação da infraestrutura de TI e sistemas operacionais (datacenter, cabeamento estruturado, redes, automação, controle de acesso, sistemas de pesagem, entre outros).

Verificar a conformidade da execução física com os projetos, memoriais descritivos, cronogramas e contratos, em conjunto com os gerentes de projeto responsáveis por cada área.

Analisar medições, boletins de medição e relatórios de avanço físico.

Identificar desvios, não conformidades e riscos, propondo planos de ação corretiva.

Avaliar a adequação dos materiais, equipamentos e serviços utilizados, conforme especificações técnicas e normas aplicáveis (ABNT, Anatel, etc.).

Acompanhar testes, comissionamentos e entregas técnicas dos sistemas implantados.

Elaborar relatórios de auditoria e pareceres técnicos.

Apoiar o controle de custos e a fiscalização contratual, garantindo transparência e rastreabilidade das informações.

Interagir com equipes de tecnologia da informação, engenharia civil, elétrica e de automação para assegurar a integração entre as disciplinas da obra.

Verificar a conformidade com normas de segurança, meio ambiente e boas práticas de engenharia.

Requisitos:

Formação:

Ensino técnico ou superior completo em Engenharia (Elétrica, Civil, de Telecomunicações, de Computação ou correlata).

Experiência:

Experiência em auditoria, fiscalização ou gerenciamento de obras e serviços de infraestrutura de TI, datacenters, telecomunicações ou sistemas operacionais industriais/logísticos.

Vivência em projetos de implantação de sistemas integrados de operação em terminais, portos, aeroportos ou centros logísticos será um diferencial.

Competências Técnicas:

Leitura e interpretação de projetos executivos e diagramas técnicos.

Conhecimento em redes estruturadas, energia redundante, automação e integração de sistemas.

Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de controle de obras e gestão de projetos (MS Project, Power BI, etc.).

Competências Comportamentais:

Rigor técnico e atenção a detalhes.

Postura ética e imparcial.

Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação.

Organização e capacidade analítica.

Condições de Trabalho:

Permanência em campo (Dom Aquino/Primavera do Leste) durante as fases de implantação.

Regime de trabalho presencial.

Vaga temporária: 6 meses.

Gestão de Serviços de Facilities

  • Avaliar performance dos fornecedores e propor planos de melhoria.

Gestão Orçamentária e Indicadores

description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Target Management and Performance Tracking: Assist the business leader in setting and breaking down team sales targets, establish mechanisms for goal tracking and analysis, monitor and report sales data and performance to ensure the achievement of team goals.

  6. Cross-Department Communication and Collaboration: Serve as a bridge between the business leader and the sales team, promote collaboration among sales, technical, product, and other teams to ensure smooth information flow and successful project delivery.

  1. At least 2 years of experience in sales operations, training support, or team management; experience in B2B business, internet, or technical roles is preferred.

  6. Proactive, highly responsible, with strong teamwork spirit and cross-departmental collaboration awareness.

Job Highlights

  1. Deep involvement in team management and business process optimization, contributing to core business goals.
  2. Join an international team, collaborate with colleagues from 26 countries, and enhance global vision and cross-cultural abilities.
  3. Be part of an early-stage business, face diverse challenges and growth opportunities, and quickly advance personal capabilities.

title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.

What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Organic Chemistry"

If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.

Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Organic Chemistry" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.

The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.

*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.

Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.

Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.

Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.

How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.

Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

• Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days.

Additional Offer:

In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Guest Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board.

*The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

  • Reestruturação Operacional e de Processos: Revisar e otimizar processos internos, cortar custos que não agregam valor e implementar novos procedimentos para aumentar a eficiência operacional.
  • Implementação e Acompanhamento: Supervisionar a execução do plano de turnaround, garantindo que as estratégias sejam seguidas e ajustadas conforme necessário para atingir os objetivos de recuperação.
  • Comunicação e Negociação: Atuar como um elo de comunicação entre a diretoria, funcionários, credores e outras partes interessadas, gerenciando conflitos e expectativas.
  • Assessoria em Recuperação Judicial: Em casos mais graves, o consultor pode gerir ou assessorar a companhia em processos formais de recuperação judicial.

- Experiencia em gestão comprovada de mais de 3 anos em reestruturação de empresas em crise;

- Formação acadêmica em Administração, Contábeis, Economia, ou áreas afins;

- Facilidade para adaptar-se a diversas situações e adversidade, ambientes e níveis hierárquicos distintos;

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Company : ZEEKR is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates.

About the Role : The role involves liaising with local partners in Brazil to understand market dynamics and achieve sales targets for ZEEKR products.

Responsibilities :

  • Be responsible for liaising with local partners in Brazil, gaining an in-depth understanding of dealer needs and market dynamics, and coordinating internal resources to achieve Zeekr Group's sales targets in the Brazilian market.
  • Take charge of and support the introduction of new Zeekr products in the target Brazilian market, conduct product analysis, and strategically launch products based on Brazilian consumer habits, policies, and regulations.
  • Coordinate the entire process, including personnel training, promotional strategies, and after-sales services, to ensure the successful market entry of products in Brazil.
  • Assist in developing and refining the marketing management system for the Brazilian region, determine marketing models suitable for the Brazilian market, and manage regional dealers to ensure sales targets are met.
  • Market and brand maintenance: In line with Zeekr's brand philosophy, encourage Brazilian dealers to actively carry out various brand activities to enhance Zeekr's brand awareness in the Brazilian market.
  • Collaborate with headquarters to monitor market sentiment in Brazil, promptly respond to negative sentiment, and handle it appropriately.
  • Follow up and supervise the channel construction plans of Brazilian partners, promoting the expansion of sales terminals and enhancing brand awareness.
  • Travel locally in Brazil for business operations, conducting market research, driving sales growth, and expanding channels.
  • Track dealer payments, production scheduling, and shipping bookings to ensure the achievement of annual terminal and wholesale targets in the Brazilian market.
  • Analyze dealer sales inventory data, identify reasons for underperformance, and propose improvement measures.
  • Regularly report to regional supervisors and the South American branch on business operations.

Qualifications :

  • Bachelor's degree or higher preferred.
  • 3-5 years of experience in the automotive industry with solid foreign trade knowledge preferred.
  • Familiarity with new energy vehicle products and sensitivity to trends in the new energy vehicle industry.
  • Experience in fast-moving consumer goods retail (e.g., digital electronics) preferred.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, outgoing personality.
  • Proficient in using office software.
  • Fluent in Chinese and English, proficiency in Portuguese preferred.

Required Skills :

  • Strong communication, coordination skills, and proficiency in office software.

Preferred Skills :

  • Familiarity with new energy vehicle products and experience in fast-moving consumer goods retail.

Pay range and compensation package : Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement : ZEEKR is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.

Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.

Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Presencial

O seu dia a dia:

Organizar a agenda do executivo, controlando compromissos, reuniões, viagens e prazos; secretariando o executivo, assessorando nas demandas diárias, triando assuntos, atendendo ligações nacionais e internacionais, controlando e-mails em português e inglês, recepcionando visitantes e apoiando logisticamente; preparando e redigindo relatórios, cartas, comunicados, memorandos e documentos executivos em um ou mais idiomas; realizando reservas de hotéis, passagens, transporte e providências logísticas para viagens e compromissos externos; organizando reuniões internas e externas, incluindo convites, pautas, materiais de apoio e suporte aos participantes, bem como realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo. Assessorar o Presidente de Controlada sendo um (a) facilitador (a) no que diz respeito às diversas tarefas desempenhadas por ele, dando todo o suporte necessário para busca dos resultados da Presidência. Principais Atividades/Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como interlocutor(a), em nome da presidência, com áreas de apoio (especialmente Comunicação);
  • Organizar a agenda do executivo, controlando compromissos, reuniões, viagens e prazos para assegurar o cumprimento eficiente das obrigações e apoiar a priorização estratégica da rotina;
  • Secretariar o executivo, assessorando-o nas demandas diárias por meio da triagem de assuntos, atendimento de ligações nacionais e internacionais, controle de e-mails em português e inglês, recepção de visitantes e apoio logístico completo;
  • Preparar e redigir relatórios, cartas, comunicados, memorandos e outros documentos executivos em um ou mais idiomas para garantir clareza, padronização e suporte às comunicações institucionais;
  • Realizar reservas de hotéis, passagens, transporte e demais providências logísticas para viagens e compromissos externos, garantindo pontualidade, organização e representatividade do executivo;
  • Organizar reuniões internas e externas, incluindo convites, pautas, materiais de apoio e suporte aos participantes para assegurar a fluidez dos encontros e a qualidade da experiência executiva;
  • Triar, priorizar e encaminhar e-mails, documentos e correspondências conforme critérios técnicos e normas internas para filtrar demandas, evitar sobrecargas e garantir que o executivo atue sobre os assuntos críticos no tempo necessário;
  • Manter atualizados os arquivos físicos e digitais do executivo, realizando classificação, etiquetagem, arquivamento e recuperação de documentos estratégicos para garantir rastreabilidade, integridade e segurança das informações;
  • Controlar, quando solicitado, atividades de apoio operacional, como serviços de copa, limpeza e organização da sala executiva, para assegurar ambiente adequado à condução das atividades de liderança;
  • Apoiar a comunicação com outros executivos, brasileiros ou estrangeiros, respeitando diferenças culturais e utilizando idioma apropriado para fortalecer a imagem institucional e facilitar o relacionamento internacional.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PLR;
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

  • Conhecimento em CyberArk ou cofres de credenciais.
  • Vivência em projetos de governança corporativa e auditoria.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor
description:
Job Description:

The Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading all Engineering teams within the plant, ensuring flawless and successful product launches and robust high-volume production processes. This role provides both functional and disciplinary leadership to manufacturing engineers and process technicians, guaranteeing performance, quality, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing activities..

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Management

  • Provide functional and disciplinary leadership to the Manufacturing Engineering teams.
  • Oversee process technicians, ensuring alignment with plant goals and operational excellence.
  • Lead decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and budgeting activities.
  • Monitor and control KPIs, define objectives, and ensure effective performance management and staff development.
  • Prepare and deliver regular reports to the Plant Manager.

Manufacturing Engineering

  • Lead Mechanical Engineering teams on all topics required to ensure program success from launch to mass production.
  • Ensure that robust, efficient, and safe production processes are implemented and sustained on the shop floor.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives following Mechanical Engineering standards, Lean methods, and EBOS principles.
  • Monitor process performance and ensure processes consistently deliver the expected results.

Engineering Change & Transfers

  • Own and manage local Engineering Change Management for product and process modifications, ensuring minimal impact on mass production lines.
  • Lead and oversee production transfers to and from the plant, ensuring seamless execution.

Quality & Customer Requirements

  • Ensure all customer requirements are met, including corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support product design and development activities to ensure compliance with manufacturing standards and process capabilities.

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
  • Post-graduate degree or MBA in engineering, manufacturing, management, or related areas.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in manufacturing engineering within an industrial environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and mechanical engineering applications in production.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with engineering change management (product and process).
  • Solid understanding of performance indicators, strategic planning, and budget management.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Inspirational, results-driven leadership.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
  • Proactive, organized, and with a strong systems-thinking mindset.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

title: Analista de Classificação Fiscal
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Analista, você irá atuar:

  • Realizar a classificação fiscal de peças
  • Analisar e identificar as peças
  • Realizar estudos de classificação alternativa
  • Elaborar relatórios e pareceres
  • Deverá acessar o sistema e realizar a classificação fiscal das peças importadas para que o departamento fiscal consiga com o processo
  • Realizar analise e identificação das peças a fim de auxiliar os departamentos de importação e fiscal
  • Realizar pesquisas junto aos Pareceres e Decisoes da OMA bem como as soluções de consulta e de divergência emitidas pela Receita Federal
  • Elaborar relatoria conclusivos e pareces para os departamentos a respeito das classificaçoes

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Possuir Graduação completa em areas correlatas;
  • Experiência com classificação fiscal
  • Conhecimento de toda a estrutura do Sistema Harmonizado e tabelas dele oriundas, tais como NCM, TIPI, TEC

title: IT Applications and Analytics Analyst LATAM
description:
Company Description

Red Bull gives wings to all people, to fly in whichever direction they want, respecting and tolerating the trajectory of each one, regardless of gender expression, race, religion, affective-sexual orientation, origin, age or disability. In the world of Red Bull, everyone is welcome.

The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM acts upon the global IT strategy, is responsible for the IT relevant coordination and communication of global business applications, their deployments within the area and head-coach regions, supporting demand process and service ownership for regional and local business applications.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· The IT Application & Analytics LATAM works thoroughly aligned with HQs BA service owners, HQ Data Team, BRMs and local peers of IT and business to ensure staying informed about relevant projects for counterparts in countries.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is responsible for service ownership and management of specific LATAM Analytics products.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is also responsible for assessing insights related demands from the different areas of the business (sales , logistics, marketing, etc), scoping the need and identifying the right technology together with it’s counterparts in LATAM or HQ. For the realization of analytics demands, the IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM either relies on the skillset of other peers in the organization or will directly integrate and visualize data.

DEMAND CAPTURE & ALIGNMENT PROCESS SUPPORT

· Person acts as regional counterpart for Analytics requests.

· Capturing, scoping, documenting and prioritizing local demands (incl. HQ security or local privacy requirements).

· Thorough understanding of the underlying business case.

· Enabling the business-to-business communication.

· Ensuring a well-prepared and transparent decision process.

· Communication and explanation of taken decisions.

SUPPORTING SERVICE DELIVERY & PROJECTS

· Project oversight for global or regional projects.

· Project documentation and action plans on communication, training, handover, support.

· Stakeholder communication.

· Third Party Management.

· Satisfaction of business and users with new services or the operation throughout.

SUPPORTING SERVICE OWNERSHIP, OPERATION & CSI PROCESSES

· Service ownership for aligned and agreed regional services.

· Management and coordination of external support & development partners.

· Alignment with local and global service owners to ensure strategy fit of solutions.

· Alignment, development and maintenance of service roadmaps within the IT area.

· Ensure country requirements are communicated to global service owners.

· Regular review of operational KPIs to ensure insights on the service knowledge and performance are generated and improvement actions are derived.

ANALYTICS

· Assessing analytics demands from teams across the area LATAM.

· Performing user interviews to understand the different interests of the people involved.

· Analyzing the different data involved and their sources.

· Working with HQ Data committee to define a goal for the data visualization.

· Identifying data integration options, methods and technology.

· Aligning the approach with decision makers in the area LATAM and HQ.

· Support the realization process through externals or realization autonomously depending on the topic and the skill set.

· Closing demands ensuring success.

· Documenting and managing analytics use cases throughout their lifecycle.

Qualifications

Degree in computer science, business informatics or equivalent experience.

Strong communicator and relator, solid and broad business process understanding.

Project Management experience, ITIL knowhow beyond theory.

Team-oriented, self-driven and motivated personality, hands-on and flexible, thinking from the end.

Ability to understand complex and different types of requirements and translate those into technical concepts.

Excellent skills to interact with all levels of employees/executives.

Precise, systematic, accuracy and structured way of working.

Performance and result orientation.

Spoken and written English mandatory, Spanish a plus.

Strong mathematical skills to help collect, measure, organize and analyze data.

Interest or experience on working with analytics skills, such as data management and visualization.

Technical proficiency regarding database design development, data models, techniques for data mining and segmentation.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Company Description

RockSpoon is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team on-site in São Paulo. In this leadership role, you will craft and oversee user experiences that are exceptionally intuitive, requiring no training or tooltips for users. You will champion a design philosophy that emphasizes clarity, minimalism, and intuitive design thinking to achieve outstanding usability across our product line. Working across our cross-platform suite (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), you will leverage effective visual hierarchy, layout, and interaction cues to guide users effortlessly. This full-time position involves collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers; you will also mentor team members and shape our design system to deliver an exceptional user experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead intuitive UX design: Lead the design of clear, self-explanatory user interfaces and workflows. Leverage visual hierarchy, layout, and intuitive interaction cues to guide users, ensuring the product is so intuitive that no training or tooltips are needed.
  • Product design strategy: Drive the UX/UI design strategy with a strong focus on usability, minimalism, and intuitive design principles. Align design objectives with product goals to deliver a simple, elegant, and highly usable experience for users.
  • Cross-platform oversight: Oversee and contribute to the design of features across mobile and desktop platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Ensure a consistent, seamless user experience that respects platform-specific guidelines while maintaining a unified product identity.
  • Design and prototyping: Create detailed wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design concepts. Iterate quickly based on feedback and usability findings to refine the user experience.
  • Design system ownership: Own and evolve RockSpoon’s design system and style guides. Establish UI standards and reusable components that promote a cohesive, intuitive, and minimalist interface across all products.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders from concept through launch. Ensure feasibility of designs and a smooth handoff to development, while advocating for the best user experience.
  • Mentorship and leadership: Mentor and provide guidance to mid-level and junior designers. Foster a culture of user-centered, intuitive design thinking within the team through knowledge sharing, code/design reviews, and continuous feedback.
  • User research & testing: Champion user research and usability testing efforts. Plan or participate in user interviews, UI tests, and analytics reviews to validate design decisions, using insights to continuously improve the product’s clarity and ease of use.
  • Usability and accessibility standards: Ensure all designs meet high standards for usability and accessibility. Deliver a frictionless, responsive experience for a diverse user base, and refine interactions to eliminate pain points and confusion.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a similar role, with significant experience leading design projects or initiatives. Proven track record of delivering successful and intuitive digital products or features.
  • Portfolio: An outstanding portfolio showcasing your product design work. Should include examples of complex applications you’ve made simple through intuitive design, demonstrating excellent usability, visual clarity, and minimalistic style.
  • Expert UX/UI knowledge: Deep knowledge of user experience principles and interaction design. Comfortable with information architecture, user flows, and usability heuristics. Ability to simplify complex workflows and create interfaces that feel natural to users.
  • Cross-platform expertise: Extensive experience designing for a range of platforms – native mobile (iOS and Android) and web/desktop applications. Familiarity with the best practices and constraints of each platform, and ability to create cohesive experiences across them.
  • Design tools & systems: Mastery of design and prototyping tools, especially Figma. Strong experience in building or maintaining design systems and component libraries. Able to enforce and evolve a consistent design language at scale.
  • Leadership & collaboration: Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead design discussions, clearly communicate design rationale, and influence product strategy. Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams and working closely with engineering and product management.
  • Intuitive design mindset: Demonstrated intuitive design thinking and problem-solving ability. Passion for usability and minimalism – you instinctively design solutions that feel easy and obvious to the end user, without extraneous complexity.
  • Communication & language: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (required for daily use). Portuguese language skills are a plus and will be helpful in the local office environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

UTS Group is seeking a highly organised, confident, and proactive Sales Project Coordinator to support our sales department from start to finish. The ideal candidate is not afraid to make decisions , can manage multiple moving parts at once, and thrives in a structured, fast-paced environment.

This role ensures sales opportunities flow smoothly into well-coordinated projects—managing communication, documentation, scheduling, and follow-ups while supporting both our clients and internal teams.

This is a 100% full-remote position , requiring discipline, ownership, and strong communication.

1. Sales Support & Opportunity Management

  • Act as the communication link between sales, operations, vendors, and clients

4. Documentation & Organisation

  • Organise and maintain all project files, documentation, and communication history

5. Financial & Administrative Support

6. Risk Management & Problem Solving

description:
A Amaris Consulting é uma empresa de consultoria tecnológica independente que fornece orientação e soluções às empresas.

Estamos buscando um Consultor de Supply Chain com experiência em SAP APO e conhecimento prático em OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) para atuar em projetos estratégicos de transformação digital na cadeia de suprimentos. Neste papel, você será responsável por mapear, otimizar e implementar processos de planejamento avançado (Demand, Supply, Production, Distribution e S&OP), garantindo a integração eficaz entre sistemas como SAP APO, OMP e SAP ERP .

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar clientes em todas as fases do projeto.
  • Mapear e otimizar processos de planejamento da cadeia de suprimentos:
  • Demand Planning
  • Supply Planning
  • Production Planning
  • Distribution Planning
  • S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning)
  • Configurar módulos do OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) de acordo com requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Garantir a integração eficiente entre OMP, SAP APO e SAP ERP , em colaboração com equipes de TI e negócios.
  • Realizar workshops com stakeholders para levantamento de necessidades e validação de soluções.
  • Ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave e promover boas práticas de planejamento colaborativo.
  • Prestar suporte pós-implantação , identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Analisar métricas de desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação ou suporte a sistemas avançados de planejamento :
  • SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS)
  • OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) – desejável
  • Outros: Kinaxis, o9, IBP (diferencial)
  • Domínio dos processos de planejamento integrado da cadeia de suprimentos .
  • Experiência com SAP ERP, SAP HANA e integração entre sistemas.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e uso de indicadores de performance (KPIs de supply chain).
  • Inglês avançado – capacidade de atuar em times globais e com clientes internacionais .

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Principal Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $7.000 USD

What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.

  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.

  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.

Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis, com foco em integração, transformação e governança de dados na plataforma Snowflake.

Projetar e implementar soluções de ingestão e orquestração utilizando Azure Data Factory, Databricks e outras ferramentas do ecossistema Azure.

Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (REST, SOAP, OData APIs), garantindo a qualidade, consistência e performance dos processos.

Modelar dados corporativos com boas práticas de modelagem relacional (E/R, normalização, chaves primárias e estrangeiras).

Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos e engenheiros de dados para desenhar soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta disponibilidade.

Administrar e versionar código por meio do GitHub e CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), aplicando automação e boas práticas de deploy.

Gerenciar componentes da infraestrutura Azure, como Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Logic Apps e Azure Functions.

Monitorar performance, custos e qualidade dos pipelines, aplicando tunning e melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Colaborar com times globais em ambiente ágil, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.

O que você precisa ter

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Data Engineer, com atuação prática em desenvolvimento de pipelines e soluções de dados em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Azure Data Factory, Snowflake e Databricks, com experiência em integração, transformação e governança de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, incluindo transformação, otimização e performance tuning.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados e manipulação de dados semiestruturados (JSON, XML, Parquet).
  • Vivência com CI/CD, GitHub Actions e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Sólida compreensão da infraestrutura Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, monitoramento, Azure Functions).
  • Experiência com orquestração e agendamento de jobs (ADF triggers, Logic Apps, FiveTran).
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente internacional.

Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com estratégias de governança e segurança de dados (GDPR, criptografia, controle de acesso).
  • Vivência com monitoramento de qualidade de dados e frameworks de controle.
  • Conhecimento em otimização de custos e performance em ambientes cloud.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e atuação em times multifuncionais.
  • Capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e habilidade para propor soluções sustentáveis e eficientes.

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager

**Add resumes in English**

In this role, you will collaborate with key infrastructure stakeholders and business partners in defining project scope, interpreting requirements and priorities, and leading the modernization and transformation of systems. The projects you lead will primarily include infrastructure and application integrations and other infrastructure initiatives. Ideally you are highly skilled in communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and C-Suite Executives and you have a well-rounded understanding of the various components of an enterprise IT environment.

Responsabilities:

• Drive project management decisions, governance, and long-term vision.

• Analyze divisional business requirements and translate these into technical deliverables organized as Executive Milestones (In/Out of Scope).

• Develop expert 'As Is' knowledge of platform systems and help define 'To Be' system solutions and flows (e.g., must understand before planning).

• Understand infrastructure requirements and deployment of solutions for OnPrem and Cloud Computing service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).

• Analyze data to identify key insights and apply them to the business; quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Ensure coordination of teams to drive timely completion of deliverables of large projects.

• Manage project budgets and financials, including resource allocations supporting a project’s schedule.

• Define and provide KPI’s and metrics for assigned projects.

• Interact closely with stakeholders and vendors and provide communications to executive management.

• Operationally troubleshoot or lead the troubleshooting of complex issues.

• Proactively ensure compliance (processes, standards, methodology) with expected quality.

• Responsible for project-related organizational change management including communications, training, and adoption.

• General understanding of infrastructure requirements to deploy solutions for storage, middleware, DB, voice specifics (call/contact centers), and network (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancing, WAF).

• Definition, implementation, and adoption of processes.

Requirements:

• Advanced English (mandatory)

• Bachelor’s degree and solid experience in Project/Program Management.

• Experience managing merger and acquisition infrastructure and application integration or divestiture projects preferred.

• Project Management Professional and/or Certified Scrum Master preferred.

• Experience managing requirements for multiple large, complex, and cross functional projects. Emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign, and knowledge of technical environments.

• Experience producing detailed project plans and resource requirements.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills – must be comfortable speaking and writing interacting with C-level audiences, as well as technical and non-technical audiences.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and negotiation skills.

• Proven ability to write business requirements, including user stories, use case development and work-flow documentation.

• Product and project management skills; business judgment, including ability to balance resources, evaluate and address risks, and concisely articulate where trade-off decisions are to be made.

• Strong orientation to user-base, including ability to understand needs and apply this knowledge to product enhancements, online user experience, and communication content (internal and external).

title: Tax Manager
description:
1. Tax Planning & Structure Design:

Develop tax-efficient structures for domestic and cross-border transactions aligned with business models. Evaluate related-party transaction frameworks and optimize tax liabilities. Conduct tax due diligence for investment and M&A projects, identifying risks and proposing actionable strategies to support strategic objectives.

2. Compliance & Risk Mitigation:

Review contractual tax clauses and operational arrangements to ensure compliance. Lead responses to tax audits and disputes, enhancing internal controls to minimize penalties and protect corporate interests.

3. Policy Analysis & Implementation:

Monitor global tax policy changes and assess business impacts. Facilitate tax incentive applications and policy adaptation, delivering compliance strategies to enable efficient operations.

4. System & Process Optimization:

Drive digital transformation of tax systems (e.g., automated export rebates, filings). Design data monitoring models and SOPs to improve tax management accuracy and integration with business and finance.

5. Cross-Border Collaboration:

Coordinate with domestic and international teams on tax filings, refunds, and intermediary oversight. Resolve cross-border tax issues, supporting global expansion and local compliance.

6. Special Projects & Capability Building:

Lead tax training programs and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Address complex tax challenges and ad-hoc tasks, ensuring comprehensive tax support for business needs.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.

Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.

Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.
